title: Product-grounded epic delivery — four reviewed dev outcomes
description: Draft: dev-baseline checkpoint, then four implementation/deployment/integration/human-review stages. Reuses prepared fixtures. Complete actual operation/release/environment bindings before activation; no flow is started by this document. Stage 4 migration and qualification-harness implementation run independently after stage 3 acceptance; final qualification joins both.

epic_metadata.title: Product-grounded epic flows
epic_metadata.description: One Product per flow, planning epic C, story issues and PRs in A/B. Four deployed outcomes after a verified dev baseline; no new Project workflow or Product-to-repository catalog.
